Frequently asked questions

What are research peptides?
Research peptides are synthetic or naturally occurring amino acid chains studied in laboratory settings for their biological properties. They are sold strictly for in-vitro research use and are not intended for human or veterinary consumption.
Who can purchase from Peppy?
You must be 21 years of age or older and purchasing for lawful research purposes only. By completing a purchase, you confirm you are a qualified researcher and will handle products in a controlled laboratory environment.
Where do you ship?
We currently ship within Canada only. Orders are typically processed within 1–2 business days and shipped discreetly.
What payment methods do you accept?
We accept USDC, BTC, and e-Transfer. Payment details are provided at checkout.
How are your products tested?
Every batch is independently tested by accredited third-party laboratories including Freedom Diagnostics, Janoshik, Uzorak, Testides, and ILS Laboratories. Testing covers purity analysis, identity verification, and endotoxin testing. All certificates are publicly available on our Lab Reports page.
What purity standards do you require?
We require 99%+ HPLC-verified purity for all products. Actual purity data for each batch is published on our Lab Reports page — if a batch doesn't meet our standards, it doesn't get listed.
How should research peptides be stored?
Lyophilized (freeze-dried) peptides should be stored at -20°C and kept away from light and moisture. Once reconstituted, store at 4°C and use within an appropriate timeframe as determined by your research protocol.
